instructions: Verified decision tree. Match the one leaf whose field conditions all hold, then return its label. Every declared input matches exactly one leaf.
If risk=FALSE, action=approve, context=internal, role=admin, return review.
If risk=FALSE, action=approve, context=internal, role=analyst, return review.
If risk=FALSE, action=approve, context=internal, role=guest, return uncertain.
If risk=FALSE, action=approve, context=partner, return allow.
If risk=FALSE, action=approve, context=sandbox, return deny.
If risk=FALSE, action=change, return deny.
If risk=FALSE, action=delete, role=admin, context=internal, return review.
If risk=FALSE, action=delete, role=admin, context=partner, return allow.
If risk=FALSE, action=delete, role=admin, context=sandbox, return allow.
If risk=FALSE, action=delete, role=analyst, return review.
If risk=FALSE, action=delete, role=guest, context=internal, return allow.
If risk=FALSE, action=delete, role=guest, context=partner, return allow.
If risk=FALSE, action=delete, role=guest, context=sandbox, return uncertain.
If risk=TRUE, return deny.
If risk=UNKNOWN, context=internal, action=approve, role=admin, return review.
If risk=UNKNOWN, context=internal, action=approve, role=analyst, return review.
If risk=UNKNOWN, context=internal, action=approve, role=guest, return allow.
If risk=UNKNOWN, context=internal, action=change, return deny.
If risk=UNKNOWN, context=internal, action=delete, role=admin, return review.
If risk=UNKNOWN, context=internal, action=delete, role=analyst, return review.
If risk=UNKNOWN, context=internal, action=delete, role=guest, return allow.
If risk=UNKNOWN, context=partner, action=approve, role=admin, return review.
If risk=UNKNOWN, context=partner, action=approve, role=analyst, return review.
If risk=UNKNOWN, context=partner, action=approve, role=guest, return allow.
If risk=UNKNOWN, context=partner, action=change, return deny.
If risk=UNKNOWN, context=partner, action=delete, role=admin, return review.
If risk=UNKNOWN, context=partner, action=delete, role=analyst, return review.
If risk=UNKNOWN, context=partner, action=delete, role=guest, return allow.
If risk=UNKNOWN, context=sandbox, return uncertain.

dsl.final_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    (event.risk == TRUE) or (event.action == change)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == sandbox)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == guest) and (event.context != sandbox)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = deny

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskCase:
    when ((not (Critical(event))) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)) and (event.context != sandbox)
    then prefer label = review priority 90

rule TrustedDelete:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == delete)
    then prefer label = allow priority 80

rule ApproveInSandbox:
    when (event.action == approve) and (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = deny priority 70

rule AnalystOrInternal:
    when (event.role == analyst) or (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = review priority 40

rule TrustedForbidReview:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = review

rule OtherRoles:
    when (((not (Critical(event))) and (not (Trusted(event)))) and (event.role != guest)) and (event.role != analyst)
    then prefer label = allow priority 1

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch1:
    when ((event.action == approve) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)) and (event.role == guest)
    then require label = allow

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch2:
    when ((event.action == approve) and (event.context == partner)) and (event.risk == FALSE)
    then require label = allow

predicate Critical(event):
    (event.risk == TRUE) or (event.action == change)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == sandbox)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == guest) and (event.context != sandbox)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = deny

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskCase:
    when ((not (Critical(event))) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)) and (event.context != sandbox)
    then prefer label = review priority 90

rule TrustedDelete:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == delete)
    then prefer label = allow priority 80

rule ApproveInSandbox:
    when (event.action == approve) and (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = deny priority 70

rule AnalystOrInternal:
    when (event.role == analyst) or (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = review priority 40

rule TrustedForbidReview:

rule OtherRoles:
